childWelfare.title: Child Welfare
childWelfare.intro: We stand beside vulnerable children through shelter, education support, counseling, and family reintegration services that help them grow with safety and hope.
childWelfare.sectionText: Our child welfare programs focus on immediate support and long-term resilience by connecting children with mentors, nutrition support, and trauma-informed care.

highlights.title: Safe shelter
highlights.description: Temporary housing and family care for children facing crisis.

highlights.title: Learning support
highlights.description: School supplies, tutoring, and scholarships for brighter futures.

highlights.title: Emotional care
highlights.description: Counseling and care circles that help children heal and thrive.

details.title: Building safer futures for vulnerable children
details.description: Every child deserves a safe place to grow, learn, and feel supported. Our child welfare initiatives work with families, schools, shelters, and community partners to provide practical support while creating pathways toward long-term stability.
details.mission: To protect vulnerable children and create safe environments where they can learn, recover, develop confidence, and build hopeful futures.

approach.title: Protection first
approach.description: We connect children facing unsafe conditions with trusted protection networks, temporary shelter, and family support.

approach.title: Education continuity
approach.description: We help children remain connected to school through learning materials, tutoring, scholarships, and mentorship.

approach.title: Family reintegration
approach.description: Where appropriate and safe, we work with families and community partners to support stable reunification.

approach.title: Long-term wellbeing
approach.description: Counseling, nutrition, mentoring, and community care help children develop resilience beyond immediate crisis.

impact.title: Our impact
impact.description: Through coordinated child protection, education, and family support, we help vulnerable children move from crisis toward stability and opportunity.
points: Greater access to nutrition and basic care

detailCta.title: Help create a safer childhood

approach.title: Keep children learning

approach.title: Strengthen teachers

health.title: Health
health.intro: We invest in clinics, mobile health camps, maternal support, and wellness outreach so families can receive care close to home.
health.sectionText: Our health initiatives focus on preventive medicine, nutrition, awareness, and partnerships with local clinics to meet real community needs.

highlights.title: Mobile clinics
highlights.description: Regular outreach to remote neighborhoods for checkups and wellness guidance.

highlights.title: Maternal care
highlights.description: Support for mothers before, during, and after childbirth.

highlights.title: Nutrition programs
highlights.description: Balanced meals and health education for children and families.

details.title: Making essential healthcare easier to reach
details.description: Many families face barriers to healthcare because of distance, cost, limited information, or lack of local services. Our programs bring preventive and supportive care closer to communities.
details.mission: To improve access to essential healthcare, preventive services, maternal support, nutrition, and health education for underserved families.

approach.title: Community outreach
approach.description: Mobile health teams visit communities where regular healthcare services are difficult to access.

approach.title: Preventive care
approach.description: Screenings, wellness education, and early intervention help families identify health concerns sooner.

approach.title: Maternal wellbeing
approach.description: Mothers receive guidance, referrals, and practical support throughout pregnancy and early motherhood.

approach.title: Nutrition awareness
approach.description: Families receive nutrition education and support designed around local needs and available resources.

impact.title: Healthier communities

detailCta.title: Help bring care closer to families
detailCta.description: Your support helps fund screenings, outreach visits, medicines, maternal care, and community health education.

cta.title: Help us expand compassionate healthcare
cta.description: Your partnership helps us reach more families with screenings, medicines, and life-saving care.

environment.title: Environment
environment.intro: We support reforestation, waste management, clean water projects, and environmental education to create healthier neighborhoods.
environment.sectionTitle: Every green action creates lasting change
environment.sectionText: From tree planting to community cleanups, our environmental programs help protect soil, water, and shared public spaces.

highlights.title: Tree planting
highlights.description: Greening vulnerable neighborhoods and restoring habitats.

highlights.title: Clean water
highlights.description: Installing safe water systems and sanitation facilities.

highlights.title: Community awareness
highlights.description: Workshops that teach families how to care for their environment.

details.title: Protecting nature through community action
details.description: Healthy communities depend on healthy ecosystems. Our environmental initiatives combine restoration, clean water, waste management, and practical education to create cleaner and more resilient neighborhoods.
details.mission: To empower communities to protect natural resources, restore green spaces, improve access to clean water, and build sustainable habits.

approach.title: Restore green spaces
approach.description: Community tree planting and habitat restoration create healthier and more resilient local environments.

approach.title: Improve water access
approach.description: Clean water and sanitation projects help reduce environmental and public health risks.

womenEmpowerment.intro: We equip women with skills, small business support, leadership training, and safe spaces to build confidence and long-term independence.
womenEmpowerment.sectionText: Our empowerment programs combine livelihood support, education, and mentorship to help women lead change in their homes and communities.

highlights.title: Microbusiness support

highlights.title: Leadership circles

details.title: Creating pathways to independence
details.description: Economic opportunity, confidence, and community support can help women build stronger futures for themselves and their families. Our programs combine practical skills with mentorship and livelihood support.
details.mission: To expand economic opportunity, leadership, confidence, and community participation for women and girls.

approach.title: Support small businesses

approach.description: Safe spaces and leadership activities help women develop confidence and participate more actively in their communities.

missionPage.title: Our Goal
missionPage.sectionTitle: Turning our mission into meaningful action
missionPage.sectionText: We believe lasting change begins with dignity, compassion, and community participation. Our work focuses on creating practical opportunities while addressing the challenges that prevent individuals and families from building secure and hopeful futures.

highlights.title: Empowering communities
highlights.description: We work alongside communities to strengthen their ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and create lasting progress.

highlights.title: Protecting dignity
highlights.description: Every person deserves safety, respect, opportunity, and the ability to participate meaningfully in their community.

highlights.title: Creating lasting change
highlights.description: We focus on sustainable solutions that continue creating benefits beyond individual campaigns and short-term interventions.

details.title: Our mission is to create opportunity where it is needed most
details.description: We exist to support people and communities facing barriers to safety, education, healthcare, economic opportunity, and a healthy environment. By working with local communities and partners, we turn compassion into practical action and support people in building stronger futures.
details.mission: Our mission is to empower individuals, strengthen families, and support communities through meaningful programs that improve access to education, healthcare, protection, economic opportunity, and environmental sustainability.
details.vision: Our vision is a world where every person can live with dignity, access the opportunities they need to thrive, and participate in building a safer, healthier, more inclusive, and sustainable future.

values.title: Dignity
values.description: We treat every individual with respect and recognize their right to safety, opportunity, and a meaningful voice.

values.title: Compassion
values.description: We listen to people's experiences and respond with empathy, care, and practical support.

values.title: Inclusion
values.description: We believe everyone should have the opportunity to participate, contribute, and benefit from a stronger community.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We are committed to responsible decisions, transparent communication, and accountable use of resources.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: We focus on solutions that create lasting benefits for people, communities, and the environment.

approach.title: Listen to communities
approach.description: We begin by understanding local needs, experiences, and priorities before developing programs and solutions.

approach.title: Create practical opportunities
approach.description: We connect people with education, healthcare, skills, resources, and support that can improve their everyday lives.

approach.title: Build local partnerships
approach.description: We collaborate with community organizations, volunteers, institutions, and local leaders to increase the reach and effectiveness of our work.

approach.title: Measure meaningful impact
approach.description: We look beyond the number of people reached and focus on the positive changes our programs create in people's lives.

approach.title: Build for the future
approach.description: We design initiatives with long-term sustainability in mind so communities can continue progressing beyond individual projects.

impact.title: The change we want to create
impact.description: Our long-term goal is to help communities become safer, healthier, more educated, economically stronger, and better equipped to create opportunities for future generations.
points: Greater access to education and learning opportunities
Safer and more supportive environments for vulnerable people
Improved access to healthcare and essential services
Stronger participation from women and young people
Stronger local organizations and community networks
Greater confidence and leadership within communities

items.question: What is an NGO?
items.answer: An NGO (Non-Governmental Organization) is a non-profit entity that works independently of government to address social, environmental, and community challenges and drive positive change.

items.question: How do you use donations?
items.answer: Your donations directly fund our ground operations including food distribution, medical assistance, education, and community development projects. We maintain full transparency through regular financial audits.

items.question: Can I volunteer with your organization?
items.answer: Yes! We welcome volunteers from all backgrounds for field distribution, educational drives, event management, and administrative support.

items.question: Are donations tax-deductible?
items.answer: Yes, all donations made to our organization are tax-deductible under applicable tax regulations. Official tax receipts are issued for every contribution.

items.question: How do you select the communities you work with?
items.answer: We conduct ground surveys and risk assessments to identify underprivileged communities experiencing critical resource shortages, prioritizing emergency aid and long-term sustainability.

items.question: How can my business partner with you?
items.answer: We offer Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) partnerships, joint fundraising events, cause marketing campaigns, and employee volunteering programs.

items.question: How can I stay updated on your activities?
items.answer: You can subscribe to our newsletter, follow us on our social media platforms, or visit our News & Blog section for field reports and project updates.

supportSection.title: We're here to support you
supportSection.description: If you have any other questions or need more information, feel free to contact us.

faq.quote: Transparency builds trust. Your questions help us grow stronger in our mission.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.text: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when registering on the platform, making a donation, or expressing interest in obtaining information about us or our campaigns.
items: Personal identifiers (Name, Email address, Phone number).
Payment details necessary to process donations securely.
Communication preferences and feedback submissions.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.text: We process your personal information for purposes based on legitimate business interests, the fulfillment of our contract with you, compliance with our legal obligations, and/or your consent.
items: To facilitate donation processing and tax receipt issuance.
To send campaign updates, newsletters, and operational alerts.
To protect our platform against fraud and security breaches.

sections.title: 3. Data Security & Storage
sections.text: We have implemented appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect the security of any personal information we process. However, please also remember that we cannot guarantee that the internet itself is 100% secure.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.text: We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to access or store information. Specific information about how we use such technologies and how you can refuse certain cookies is set out in our Cookie Notice.

sections.title: 5. Contact Us
sections.text: If you have questions or comments about this policy, you may email us at privacy@Helping Hearts.org or by post to our central office.

sections.title: 1. Donation Refund Requests
sections.text: We understand that circumstances may change after a donation has been made. If you believe a donation was made in error or you need to request a refund, please contact our support team as soon as possible with the relevant transaction details.
items: Refund requests should be submitted using our official contact channels.
Please provide the donor name, donation amount, transaction date, and transaction reference where available.
Submitting a refund request does not automatically guarantee that the donation will be refunded.

sections.title: 2. Eligible Refunds
sections.text: Refunds may be considered in situations such as duplicate transactions, incorrect donation amounts, or unauthorized transactions. Each request will be reviewed individually based on the circumstances and available transaction information.
items: Duplicate donations may be eligible for a refund after verification.
Incorrectly entered donation amounts may be reviewed for correction or refund.
Unauthorized transactions should be reported promptly so that they can be investigated.

sections.title: 3. Non-Refundable Donations
sections.text: Donations that have already been allocated or used for approved charitable activities may not be eligible for a refund. We encourage donors to carefully review their donation details before completing a transaction.
items: Completed donations may not be refundable once funds have been allocated to a program.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
sections.text: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember information about your visit and allow certain features and functionality to work properly.
items: Cookies may be stored on computers, tablets, and mobile devices.
They can help improve website performance and usability.
Cookies may remember preferences and settings from previous visits.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
sections.text: Helping Hearts may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, understand how visitors use our website, and maintain the security and functionality of our services.
items: To remember your preferences and settings.
To understand website traffic and visitor behavior.
To improve website performance and user experience.
To help detect and prevent security issues.

sections.title: 3. Types of Cookies We Use
sections.text: Different types of cookies may be used on our website depending on their purpose. Some cookies are essential for the website to function, while others help us understand website usage and improve our services.
items: Essential cookies required for basic website functionality.
Preference cookies used to remember user settings.
Analytics cookies used to understand website traffic and usage.
Security cookies used to help protect our website and users.

sections.title: 4. Managing Cookies
sections.text: You can control or manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to view, delete, block, or restrict cookies. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality or availability of some parts of our website.
items: You can delete existing cookies through your browser settings.
You can configure your browser to block certain cookies.
Some website features may not function properly if essential cookies are disabled.

sections.title: 5. Third-Party Cookies
sections.text: Some services or content provided by third parties may use their own cookies or similar technologies. These may include analytics, payment, embedded content, or other services integrated into our website.

We do not control the cookie practices of external websites or services.

sections.title: 6. Contact Us

content.author: Helping Hearts Team
content.title: Providing Free Medical Care to Rural Communities
content.intro: Our healthcare outreach camp brought together volunteer doctors, nurses, and community leaders to provide free consultations, medicines, and health awareness sessions for underserved families.
paragraphs: More than 800 villagers received health checkups during the one-day medical camp.
Children were vaccinated while women received maternal healthcare consultations.
Local volunteers also organized awareness sessions on nutrition, hygiene, and preventive healthcare.
content.quote: Healthcare should never be a privilege—it is a basic human right.
content.conclusion: With the continued support of our donors and volunteers, we aim to organize similar healthcare initiatives across more rural regions in the coming months.

content.author: Maria Chen
content.title: How Your Donations Fed Thousands of Families
content.intro: Every donation made by our supporters helped provide nutritious meals, clean water, and emergency supplies to families affected by poverty and natural disasters.
paragraphs: Over 3,000 food kits were distributed across multiple villages.
More than 500 volunteers worked tirelessly to deliver relief materials.
Local communities also received hygiene kits and educational support for children.
content.quote: Small acts of kindness create lasting change.
content.conclusion: Together, we continue creating hope and brighter futures for families who need it most.
